content: One generation plants the cedar trees; another generation enjoys the shade.
author: Chinese Proverbs
sourceWork: Qian ren zai shu, hou ren cheng liang (前人栽树，后人乘凉) — Ming Dynasty Adage
explanation: True nobility is planting a tree under whose shade you know you will never sit. The civilization that only builds for immediate gratification consumes its seed corn and leaves a desert for its children. Act with reverence for the unheralded future.
practicalInsight: Do one generous act today that benefits someone you will never meet or who can never repay you.
reflectionPrompt: What are you currently building that will offer shelter and nourishment long after your name is forgotten?
